decks.notes:
This deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing blink effects to gain value from entering the battlefield abilities of creatures. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize while establishing a strong board presence with creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Quantum Riddler. The blink effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp allow for extra triggers of powerful abilities, giving the deck an advantage in tempo and value.

Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive plays while generating card advantage through blink effects.

This deck focuses on using ramp cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Eldrazi Temple to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It aims to control the game through cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Malevolent Rumble, while also exploiting cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Fight Rigging to maintain board presence. The deck ultimately seeks to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and powerful spells, aiming to win through sheer force and control of the game.

The deck focuses on establishing a fast and aggressive board presence by utilizing a variety of low-cost and efficient creatures as well as burn spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It also includes cards that provide additional benefits or disruption to further enhance its aggressive strategy and maintain its tempo. The key strategy involves applying early pressure, disrupting the opponent's game plan, and closing out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. By using a mix of counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Toxic Deluge, the deck aims to keep the opponent's threats at bay. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw spells like Cling to Dust and Consult the Star Charts allows the player to maintain card advantage and stay ahead in the long game.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies through a combination of counter spells, discard spells, and removal spells. It aims to control the game by denying opponents resources and answering threats efficiently. By utilizing powerful cards such as Counterspell, Thoughtseize, and Fatal Push, the deck aims to stay ahead in card advantage and tempo. Additionally, it includes creatures with disruptive abilities like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Wan Shi Tong, Librarian, to further disrupt opponents' game plans. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game and outmaneuvering opponents.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bringing them back into play using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. By using instant reanimator spells and card draw effects, the deck aims to create explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures early in the game. The key strategy is to efficiently cycle through the deck, disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, and establish a dominant board presence through instant reanimation.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and efficient spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive abilities. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga to generate mana, along with powerful cards like Arcbound Ravager and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to apply pressure, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan. Additionally, cards like Engineered Explosives and Metallic Rebuke provide additional disruption to control the flow of the game in your favor.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful colorless Eldrazi creatures and Ugin planeswalkers. By assembling the UrzaTron lands, it can quickly ramp up mana to cast devastating threats such as Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Emrakul, the Promised End. With a mix of disruptive spells like Thought-Knot Seer and board control with Karn, the Great Creator, the deck aims to overpower the opponent and dominate the battlefield. Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void help to slow down the opponent's game plan, while cards like Sowing Mycospawn provide additional value and fuel for the Eldrazi.

This Esper Control deck focuses on maintaining board control and disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils. It also utilizes cards like Isochron Scepter to repeatedly cast important spells and Prismatic Ending for versatile removal. The deck aims to out value the opponent with card advantage and efficient answers, while Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides a unique companion option for additional synergy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolor requirements.

The deck focuses on utilizing ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. It looks to control the game through disruption and mana acceleration, eventually landing game-ending Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. The deck also utilizes support cards like Fanatic of Rhonas and Disciple of Freyalise to further ramp up its mana production. By using a combination of ramp, control, and powerful Eldrazi creatures, the deck aims to dominate the game and overpower its opponent.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and card advantage to dominate the game. By using counterspells, removal, and card draw effects like Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to control the board and out-value the opponent. The inclusion of Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional control elements and card advantage. The deck also features land disruption with cards like Prismatic Ending and powerful win conditions like The Wandering Emperor and March of Otherworldly Light to close out games efficiently.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude to quickly bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand back from the graveyard. It also includes a variety of disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the game. Ephemerate and Faithful Mending help to filter through the deck and find key pieces, while Prismatic Ending offers versatile removal options. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize creatures with various abilities to assemble a powerful combo that can quickly overrun the opponent. By using cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana, combined with Leyline of Abundance to make creatures bigger, the deck can ramp up to play a big threat like Craterhoof Behemoth or Ouroboroid to finish off the opponent. Additionally, the deck uses Green Sun's Zenith and creatures like Duskwatch Recruiter to tutor for key pieces and assemble the combo efficiently.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to create powerful combos and generate strong board presence. By using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Leyline of Abundance to tutor for the right creatures, the player can easily access their toolbox of cards for different situations. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to create infinite mana combos, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming opponents. Overall, the deck thrives on synergy between creatures and utilizing their abilities to dominate the battlefield.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to deal damage quickly and efficiently. With a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, alongside aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to ensure card advantage and consistency, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive strategy throughout the match.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief and various support cards such as Malevolent Rumble and Blade of the Bloodchief. By using Urza's Saga to search for key pieces, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and overwhelming advantage. The inclusion of Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End adds resilience and a potential game-ending threat. Overall, the deck seeks to create a synergistic engine that generates value and puts pressure on the opponent to quickly close out the game.
